title: Route_20
lead_summary:
Route 20 is a water-route and can only be used with Surf or its HM Replacement Item. It connects Cinnabar Island to Route 19.
The route is split with Seafoam Islands.

items.name: Pearl
items.location_details: Given by Swimmer Axel after defeating him.

items.name: Stardust
items.location_details: On the island on the southern path from [[Route 19]].

items.name: Spaceship Part
